The person on the left wears a blue cap and holds an object, while the person on the right raises an arm. The image has a heavy artistic filter applied, resulting in blocky color regions and reduced detail.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The entire image suffers from extreme posterization/compression artifacts. While likely an intentional artistic style, it results in a significant loss of texture fidelity and natural gradients, creating a 'blocky' appearance that deviates from standard photographic quality.

The facial features of the humans are heavily distorted by the filter. The person on the right has ambiguous facial geometry, and the person on the left has merged features. This looks like AI generation struggling with complex organic structures under stylistic constraints.
